newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's DBSA disburses record 1.4 billion rand.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's DBSA disburses record 1.4 billion rand.

text.p: South Africa's Development Bank of Southern Africa (DBSA) said on Tuesday it had disbursed a record 1.387 billion rand during the 1996/97 financial year and expected disbursements to top two billion this year.
A total of 2.2 billion rand of new investment loans were approved for 102 infrastruture programmes and projects, an increase of 12 percent on 1995/96.
The bank said lending was focused on reconstruction and development project priorities, with th largest portion going to bulk electricity supply and connectors.
